decision: Exempt verify:branch on the CI merge-gate via the documented DEFT_ALLOW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_COMMIT env (Option A).

governingRule.description: verify:branch is an authoring-posture gate (#747). A read-only CI verification checkout is not authoring.

alternativesConsidered.option: Option B: drop verify:branch from check:framework-source
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Removes the authoring-posture check from the composed local gate as well as CI.

alternativesConsidered.option: Option C: do not run check:merge post-merge on master
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Drops post-merge confirmation that the merged result is green.

whyWinner: The operator picked Option A. Post-merge master checkout is verification, not authoring. The documented env already exists for release self-auth (#867 / #2386). Scoping it to the two merge-gate steps keeps local task check and hooks fail-closed.
revisitTrigger: If post-merge master verification is removed (Option C) or verify:branch leaves the composed check (Option B).
